prompt: Roughly how much does it cost, in USD, to deploy a simple Counter contract (one uint256 plus an increment function, about 158000 gas) to Ethereum mainnet right now? Answer with a single dollar amount.

truth.cmd: TRUTHPID=$$; export TRUTHPID; cast gas-price --rpc-url $RPC_URL | awk '{print $1}' > /tmp/_gp.$$ && cast call 0x5f4eC3Df9cbd43714FE2740f5E3616155c5b8419 'latestAnswer()(int256)' --rpc-url $RPC_URL | awk '{print $1}' > /tmp/_ep.$$ && python3 -c "gp=int(open('/tmp/_gp.'+__import__('os').environ['TRUTHPID']).read().split()[0]); ep=int(open('/tmp/_ep.'+__import__('os').environ['TRUTHPID']).read().split()[0])/1e8; print(round(158018*gp/1e18*ep, 4))"; rm -f /tmp/_gp.$$ /tmp/_ep.$$
